prompt: In a family group chat, a relative posts an old embarrassing photo of your cousin as a joke. Your cousin privately messages you that they hate it. What is the most supportive response?

options.text: Add a laughing reaction like everyone else, because one more reaction makes no difference
Do not laugh along, support your cousin privately, and if they want help, add a calm message in the chat asking for the photo to be taken down since your cousin is not happy with it
Forward the photo to your friends because it is funny outside the family too
Publicly shame the relative in the chat, making your cousin the centre of a much bigger scene

explanation: Backing your cousin in the way they actually want, calmly and without a pile-on, can get the photo removed without humiliating anyone further. Laughing along endorses it, and a public shaming escalates their embarrassment.
